_doc: Animation manifest (docs/remodel/05-animations.md §7, docs/ATTACK_ANIMATIONS.md 'Manifest-driven clips'). Read by loadManifest() in js/render/attack-anims.js. Times in s. trim: [start, end] in the set file's clip, null = whole clip. markers: s into the TRIMMED clip. files: false = not produced yet (not fetched, its clips use `fallback`); tools/anim-extract.mjs --set flips it to true. measured: false = placeholder markers (05 §4), measure before tuning. Loops are closed at load (last key = first key, error spread over the clip); inPlace (default true) keeps the pelvis where it started. stride = metres per loop of the trimmed clip on a 1.95 m champion. offL: the left arm is held in the idle pose (the shield stays in guard).
